灯笼街的一天(A Day at the lantern street): 围绕节日文化的A1短文:介绍安娜的日常、喜好与灯笼街。
Sam often helps me with music. I like my life very much. Anna and Sam are in the same class. Best of all, I was scared when the oil in the pan jumped.
After school, we play together. Anna drinks water every morning. We talk about music a lot. The diaper bag doubles as a pillow.
The lantern street is not far from my home. Anna wants to visit London. The lantern street is my favorite place.
